title: Boy Playing Fetch with Dog in Backyard, 1956 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming August 1956 black-and-white snapshot capturing a young boy in a zip-up jacket and jeans playing fetch with his German Shepherd dog in a grassy suburban backyard. The boy holds up a ball, poised to throw, while the focused dog gazes upward awaiting the toss. The print features classic mid-century deckled edges and an authentic 'AUG 56' processing stamp along the bottom border, capturing quintessential 1950s American childhood leisure and pet companionship.
